questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Fondation Danoise is the best option for Danish students studying abroad in Paris.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: If you live at Fondation Danoise transportation is fairly easy.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: You have to get the classes approved in advance even if the courses aren't available. That means that you are looking at the courses from last year that might not exist anymore

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: None

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Except not getting microeconomics (because KU only approved it as two courses consisting of 15 ECTS) I got all my desired courses (electives, Danish and Comparative Politics and European Politics) approved. I however got one EP class refused that another student going to Sciences Po had gotten approved. But by insisting to the KU administration on that detail I ended up getting it approved.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Start registration in very good time, KU are not kidding when they say you can expect 6 weeks

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: BA level, second year courses

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Much more like high school where participation is keen and a big workload compared to KU

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
European Challanges and Opportunities
Decision Making processes in the EU
Comparative Politics
Strategic issues in the Sahel Region
Afghanistan

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: The Strategic Issues in the Sahel Region course is very interesting and looks at a region that is undermediatized in Denmark

Intense workload
Relevant classes that are not overtheoretical 
Great international environment to make new friends
